name: PT 5469
title: Integrated Clinical Experience, Acute Care
description: Provides students with clinical experience at hospitals and sub-acute health care facilities. Students will observe and will assist as appropriate with patient care under the supervision and direction of a licensed physical therapist. The course allows students to integrate and apply the didactic component of the curriculum in an acute or sub-acute environment. It is designed to foster the student's appreciation for the multidisciplinary nature of hospital care.
requirement_description: Students must be in good academic standing and be granted department consent.
